summary: Full regression pass on the agent-filtering bug fix + new Proven Results feature. Verified via pytest (16 API tests) + Playwright UI flows across Showcase, Proven Results, Property Detail (active & sold), Neighborhoods, homepage stats, mobile nav, and admin Sync MLS Listings. Core fix works correctly: Showcase=12 Sheila-only active/pending listings, Proven Results=129 Sheila-only sold listings, Neighborhoods=Sheila-only Active/Pending (happy-in-the-heights correctly shows 1 listing), no other-agent names leaked anywhere. Found one real data-quality bug: 12 of the 129 'sold' listings are actually lease/rental records (StandardStatus=Closed leases) with rent-level close_price ($825-$3,100), showing as 'Sold Price' on public Proven Results cards and property detail pages (e.g. /property/409-s-orleans-ave-tampa-fl-33606 shows 'Sold Price $2,350', $2/sqft) — misleading marketing data.

minor.issue: sync_agent_listings() fetches StandardStatus='Closed' listings for Proven Results but does NOT filter out lease/rental property types (Residential Lease / Commercial Lease) the way neighborhoods.py's LEASE_TYPES filter does. Result: 12 of 129 'sold' properties are actually closed leases with rent-level close_price ($825-$3,100/mo), e.g. '409 S ORLEANS AVENUE' shows Sold Price $2,350 and $2/Sq Ft on the public property detail page. Fix: filter by PropertyType/ PropertySubType != lease (e.g. StandardStatus='Closed' AND PropertyType='Residential' or similar) when building the sold/Closed sync batch, or exclude MLS records where the raw 'PropertyType'/'MlsStatus' indicates a lease before insert.

One record ('200 COUNTRY CLUB DR UNIT 1302', MLS# TB8443656) has listing_agent = 'John Desautels, II' instead of 'Sheila Desautels' / 'Sheila M Desautels'. Passed the exact ListAgentMlsId filter and the 'desautels' cleanup regex (so it's not the original bug), but worth confirming with the user whether John Desautels is an intentional co-agent/team member sharing Sheila's MLS ID, since the review scope says listings should show only Sheila's name.

integration_issues.issue: Sold property detail pages inherit the backend lease-price bug — visually confirmed 'Sold Price $2,350' and '$2/Sq Ft' badge for a 990 sqft home at 409 S Orleans Avenue.

action_items: Filter out lease/rental property types when syncing 'Closed' MLS status into Proven Results (mirror the LEASE_TYPES exclusion already used in neighborhoods.py) — this is the only real bug found.
Optionally verify with user whether 'John Desautels, II' should legitimately appear as listing_agent on one showcase listing, or should be normalized to Sheila's name.
critical_code_review_comments: properties.py is 1788 lines — consider splitting sync/public endpoints into a separate module (e.g. routes/mls_sync.py) for maintainability.

sync_agent_listings' self-healing cleanup regex ({'listing_agent': {'$not': {'$regex': 'desautels', ...}}}) is a good pragmatic guard but is coupled to the agent's surname string; if the agent name ever changes in MLS data this silently breaks — consider also cross-checking against AGENT_MLS_ID stored per-record if available.

success_rate.backend: 94% (15/16 tests passed, 1 real data-quality bug found)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI flows tested worked as expected)

seed_data_creation: None - used existing production-synced MLS data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Agent-filter fix (ListAgentMlsId exact match) is solid and verified end-to-end: Showcase (12 active/pending, all Sheila), Proven Results (129 sold, all Sheila, gold SOLD badges on cards/map popups, nav link works desktop+mobile), Property Detail pages correctly branch on isSold (SOLD badge, Sold Price label, sidebar CTA swap, Schedule Viewing button hidden for sold / present for active), Neighborhoods correctly scoped to Sheila's Active/Pending only (happy-in-the-heights shows exactly 1 listing as expected). Admin Sync MLS Listings button clicked once successfully (returned updated counts, public stats stable at 11 active/1 pending/129 sold after sync). Only open item is the lease-price bug in Proven Results described above — not related to the agent-filter fix itself, but a pre-existing data-quality gap in the new Closed-status sync path.
rca of the issue: sync_agent_listings() builds three MLS OData queries (Active/Pending/Closed) filtered only by ListAgentMlsId + StandardStatus. Unlike neighborhoods.py's get_public_neighborhood() which explicitly filters out property_type in {'residential lease','commercial lease'} after the MLS search, the sync path applies no such filter, so Stellar MLS 'Closed' records for lease listings (which also carry a StandardStatus of Closed with a ClosePrice = monthly rent) get stored with status='sold' and close_price=rent_amount, then surfaced verbatim on /api/public/proven-results and the property detail page as if they were home sale prices.
